notes.text:
click to toggle
The ६th-Case-affix is used in the remaining cases, that is to say, where there is a sense, such as the relation between property and its owner etc. different from that of a word related to a verb and from that of a Nominal-stem.
Ex. राज्ञः पुरुषः 'the king's man' पशोः पादः 'beast's foot' पितुः पुत्रः 'father's son.'
काशिका   कर्मादिभ्योऽन्यः प्रातिपदिकार्थव्यतिरिक्तः स्वस्वामिसंबन्धादिः शेषः, तत्र षष्ठी विभक्तिर्भवति। राज्ञः पुरुषः। पशोः पादः। पितुः पुत्रः॥
